statement: A pinned Pro-controller-emulator maintainer documents observing a Switch 2 console issue an initialization SPI request for 13 bytes starting at 0x6050, then another request for 25 bytes starting at 0x603D, and reports that the Switch 2 displayed four configurable controller colour fields after an overlap fix. This is reported Switch 2 console consumer behavior with a compatible emulator, not measured retail Switch Pro responses or evidence about Linux/SDL colour handling or all-0xFF fallback.

applicability.revision: wozt pcble2gamepad 97084db; Switch 2 console software revision unspecified
applicability.firmware: Switch Pro retail firmware not measured
applicability.scope: README.md lines 109-135: reported Switch 2 console interaction with an emulated original Switch Pro; no independently archived host trace, transport-generalization, or retail USB test. Adds a distinct console consumer to the Linux/SDL-only unknown in swpro-l0-consumer-colour-spi-no-evidence.
